interest: Index of Peru's 1932-34 bid to trade guano and oil for Japanese arms during Leticia conflict, monitored by US intelligence.
overview: Docket sheet (File 412) indexing 1932-34 reports on a Peruvian military mission negotiating arms for guano and oil with Japan during the Leticia dispute, tracked by Ambassador Grew and US Naval Intelligence; a reciprocal Japanese mission visited Peru in 1934.

subfiles.about: Department of State List of Papers indexing diplomatic and intelligence correspondence from September 1932 to May 1934 regarding Peruvian military missions and arms acquisitions in Japan.
subfiles.summary: This docket sheet indexes eleven sub-numbers (Sept 1932-May 1934) on Peru's military commission sent to Japan to trade guano and oil for arms during the Leticia dispute, covering US reporting from Lima, Tokyo, and Bogota, Peruvian denials, confirmation of an arms deal, and a reciprocal 1934 Japanese mission to Peru.
